description: SWA RadixCache stress test data for sglang serving. Covers prefix cache hit/miss/partial scenarios.

scenarios.name: exact_cache_hit
scenarios.description: Send identical prompts repeatedly. Second+ requests should get full prefix cache hit.

messages.content: What is the capital of France? Answer in one word.

scenarios.name: prefix_sharing_short
scenarios.description: Multiple prompts sharing the same system prompt. Prefix cache should share the system prompt KV.

messages_list.content: You are a helpful coding assistant. Always provide complete, working code examples with proper error handling.
Write a Python function to compute fibonacci numbers.

Write a Python function to sort a list using quicksort.

Write a Python function to find the longest common subsequence.

scenarios.name: multi_turn_conversation
scenarios.description: Multi-turn conversation where each turn extends the prefix. Each new turn should partially hit the prefix cache from previous turns.

scenarios.name: cache_miss_unique_prompts
scenarios.description: Completely different prompts with no shared prefix. All should be cache misses.

messages_list.content: Translate the following to French: The weather is beautiful today.
Explain quantum entanglement in simple terms.
Write a haiku about machine learning.
What are the main differences between TCP and UDP?

scenarios.name: long_context_chunked_prefill
scenarios.description: Long input that exceeds chunked_prefill_size (16384 tokens), forcing multi-chunk prefill. SWA cache should free window-external KV between chunks.

messages.content: You are a document analysis assistant. Read the entire document carefully and answer questions about it.

scenarios.name: partial_prefix_hit
scenarios.description: Prompts that share a long prefix but diverge at different points. Tests partial cache hit with SWA tail-window safety.
scenarios.shared_prefix: The following is a comprehensive analysis of renewable energy sources. Solar energy harnesses sunlight through photovoltaic cells to generate electricity. Wind energy uses turbines to convert wind kinetic energy. Hydroelectric power generates electricity from flowing water. Geothermal energy taps heat from the Earth interior. Biomass energy converts organic materials into fuel. Each source has unique advantages and limitations that must be carefully considered when planning energy infrastructure for sustainable development.
suffixes: Focusing on solar energy, what are the main efficiency challenges?
Focusing on wind energy, what are the environmental impacts?
Focusing on hydroelectric power, what are the geographical constraints?
Focusing on geothermal energy, what are the drilling costs?
Compare solar and wind energy in terms of reliability.

scenarios.name: batch_concurrent_same_prefix
scenarios.description: Send a batch of requests simultaneously, all sharing the same prefix. Tests concurrent prefix sharing under SWA cache.

scenarios.name: speculative_decode_stress
scenarios.description: Short prompts with long generation to stress EAGLE speculative decoding path (speculative_num_steps=3, topk=1, num_draft_tokens=4). SWA eviction happens on each decode step.

messages_list.content: Count from 1 to 200, one number per line.
Write the alphabet backwards, one letter per line, 10 times.
List all prime numbers between 1 and 500.

scenarios.name: eviction_pressure
scenarios.description: Send many long unique prompts rapidly to fill KV cache and trigger radix tree eviction. Tests that SimpleSWARadixCache.evict() correctly reclaims both full and SWA budgets.
scenarios.prompt_template: Write a detailed {num}-paragraph essay about the history and cultural significance of {topic}. Include specific dates, names, and places.

scenarios.name: interleaved_hit_miss
scenarios.description: Alternate between cache-hittable prompts and unique prompts. Tests cache behavior under mixed workload.
